Introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster in your projects. Starting today, every paid plan includes this feature, so there's nothing extra to configure or purchase. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most, then return to that setup in a single click instead of rebuilding it every time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving individuals and teams plenty of room to organize views around sprints, clients, priorities, or personal workflows. Need a teammate to see things the way you do? Views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered perspective without repeating setup steps or explaining configurations over chat.

Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a specific client's workload, or focusing on this week's priorities, Saved Views keeps your favorite setups within reach. We built this feature based directly on customer feedback, and we're glad to finally bring it to you.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
